audit.whatIsWrong: The ult is Lilting Lullaby; the page calls it "R (Lullaby)" in four places. Far worse, it describes it as a free "delayed sleep" she can throw at you. Riot's text: "Lillia causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy before falling asleep." It only touches enemies who ALREADY have Dream Dust — i.e. who she has already hit with an ability. A Jayce she has not landed a spell on cannot be slept by it at all.
audit.why: This is the single most actionable fact in the matchup and the page omits it entirely. "Respect it on cooldown" is unplayable advice for a 150-second ultimate; "do not let her land a spell on you before she has 6" is a rule you can actually follow, and it is the same rule as the poke plan. It also means the counterplay to a level-6 all-in is simply not being chipped, not sitting on a cooldown timer.
audit.corrected: Name corrected to Lilting Lullaby; the Dream Dust prerequisite written in as the counterplay, with the 150/130/110s cooldown and 1600 range.
sources: champ-data/_kits/lillia.json (R Lilting Lullaby: CD 150/130/110, range 1600, 'causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy before falling asleep')

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown appears anywhere on the page, in either layer, despite the full layer's whole commit rule being "track Blooming Blows before every engage".
audit.why: Blooming Blows is 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s — it is essentially always up, so tracking it is not a plan. The cooldowns that actually gate this lane are Swirlseed at a flat 12s (her only ranged tool and the thing that stops your dash) and Watch Out! Eep! at 14/13/12/11/10s. Those are the two windows where a 450-range Lillia genuinely cannot punish a step-up.
audit.corrected: Blooming Blows 6s, Swirlseed 12s, Watch Out! Eep! 14s and Lilting Lullaby 150s written into the spikes, mid and cooldown block.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart reads Skill, Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Skill, Jayce, Jayce. Level 1 reads Skill though whys[0] says "take Cannon Q and free-poke every step-up"; Levels 4-5 reads Skill though whys[3] says "you have both forms and your gate-Q out-ranges her kit"; and 2+ items reads Jayce directly above whys[6], which says "she out-scales you hard".
audit.why: The last of those is the dangerous one — it tells a Jayce with no defensive stats that the two-item duel against a full-AP Lillia is his, when the prose under it says the opposite in the same breath.
audit.corrected: Level 1 and Levels 4-5 to Jayce, 2+ items to Lillia — Jayce, Jayce, Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Jayce, Lillia.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page tells the reader that armour and magic resist are partly wasted here, and the page twice attributes her move speed to "Q/W".
audit.why: Two separate facts. Blooming Blows deals extra TRUE damage on its outer edge, so the ring she wants to catch you with punches straight through whatever resists you bought — which is exactly why she can trade into a Jayce who just shredded nothing. And the move speed is entirely on Blooming Blows' passive, which stacks when her spells hit; Watch Out! Eep! is damage only. Crediting W with move speed sends the reader watching the wrong animation for the kite.
audit.corrected: The true-damage edge named; move speed attributed to the Blooming Blows passive alone.
sources: champ-data/_kits/lillia.json (Q Blooming Blows: 'Passively, Lillia gains stacking Move Speed when hitting enemies with spells... dealing extra true damage on the edge'; W Watch Out! Eep!: 'deals damage in a nearby area, dealing heavy damage in the center')

notes: THE INTERACTION THAT WAS MISSING: Lilting Lullaby only affects enemies who ALREADY have Dream Dust on them — Riot's text is explicit. The page describes it four times as a free delayed sleep and tells the reader to "respect it on cooldown", which is unplayable advice for a 150-second ultimate. The real rule is that a Jayce she has never landed a spell on simply cannot be slept, which folds the ult counterplay into the poke plan the page already teaches. NAME: the ability is Lilting Lullaby, written "R (Lullaby)" throughout. ATTRIBUTION ERROR: the page credits move speed to "Q/W" twice. Riot's text puts stacking Move Speed entirely on Blooming Blows' passive; Watch Out! Eep! is damage only, heavy in the centre. ADDED: Blooming Blows deals extra TRUE damage on its outer edge, so the ring she wants to catch you in ignores resists — this is the real reason the missing-interactions file flags K'Sante-style resist invalidation for this matchup, and it appeared nowhere on the page. Cooldowns added: Blooming Blows 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s, Watch Out! Eep! 14/13/12/11/10s, Swirlseed 12s flat at 700 range, Lilting Lullaby 150/130/110s at 1600 range. LEVEL CHART: 2+ items read Jayce directly above whys[6] saying "she out-scales you hard"; Level 1 and Levels 4-5 read Skill above whys saying Jayce free-pokes and out-ranges her.
